generate_builder_documentation: generate documentation for TensorFlow dataset builders using iter_documentation_builders with optional dataset list and doc_util_paths
generate_collection_documentation: generate documentation for TensorFlow dataset collections using iter_collections_documentation with optional collection names
load_builder_metadata: load a TFDS dataset builder and its configs into a BuilderToDocument structure for documentation
get_builder_sections: extract documentation sections from a dataset builder class based on module path or metadata tags
format_section_header: format a section string by replacing underscores and hyphens with spaces and normalizing spelling
